**Finding: Compliant** (no redline)

The Agreement contains no most-favoured-nation provision in either direction. I confirmed this by targeted searches ("most favoured", "no less favorable/favourable", "favorable/favourable" — all zero hits) and by reading the entire document, which consists of a single section (p0000–p0074), including the Fees and Payment clause at §5 (p0023) where such terms would ordinarily sit.

Because AP is under no obligation to extend Kubient terms matching those given to third parties, this sits at the playbook's **preferred** position. Section 1 reinforces the point: the arrangement is expressly non-exclusive and "will not restrict Customer offering Inventory via other agents or otherwise selling Inventory to any third parties," so AP retains full freedom to contract elsewhere on any terms.

One observation for the record, not a deviation: the Agreement likewise grants AP no MFN in its own favour. A Vendor-granted MFN would be welcome, but its absence is not flagged under this direction rule.
